facts.text: 24 years old, Egypt — Menoufia — Shebin El Kom.
Studies at a Faculty of Commerce (كلية تجارة); not the center of identity or ambitions.
Has street/manual-work experience; does not want a future depending on working under someone else.
Builder mindset more than student mindset — learns technology to build real projects and products.
Not traditionally trained as a programmer; learned through AI-assisted building.
Target flow: Idea → System → Product/Service → Customer → Revenue → Scale.
Economic model: BUILD ONCE → SELL MANY TIMES → KEEP VALUE COMPOUNDING.
"I don't want money to become my life. I want money to buy back my life."
English is a strategic priority (UK English) as a working tool.
Started creating images with AI roughly four years ago.
